name: review-blog
description: Review Chinese blog posts for writing style, punctuation, and formatting issues.
author: Christophe1997

name: agentic-doc
description: Documentation standards for agentic programming: AGENTS.md lifecycle management and conventional commit messages.
author: Christophe1997

name: show-me-the-session
description: Export Claude Code session transcripts to solarized-light HTML with pagination support. Features: auto session detection, split output for large sessions, configurable page size.
author: Christophe1997

name: permission-notification
description: Sends macOS notifications when Claude Code needs permission to execute commands
author: Christophe1997

name: tdd
description: Test-Driven Development guidance based on Kent Beck's 'Test Driven Development: By Example'. Provides the Red/Green/Refactor workflow, 40+ named TDD patterns, and autonomous test quality review.
author: Christophe1997

name: a2a
description: A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol client — communicate with any A2A-compliant agent by URL or alias. Supports blocking and background tasks, auth params, agent aliases, and session task tracking.
author: Christophe1997

name: yapermission
description: Yet Another Permission — declarative allow / ask / deny / defer rules for Claude Code tool calls via a TOML policy, with project-overrides-global config and decision logging.
author: Christophe1997

name: go-pkg-discovery
description: Discover Go packages, modules, versions, vulnerabilities, reverse dependencies, and exported symbols via pkg.go.dev — powered by the upstream pkgsite-cli wrapper.
author: Christophe1997

name: zettel-sync
description: Maintain a structured Obsidian vault (Zettelkasten-style) from recent Claude Code sessions: harvest concepts into inbox seed notes, detect orphans, near-duplicates, and MOC gaps — all as a single batched-approval review document.
author: Christophe1997

name: best-of-three
description: Best-of-N competitive implementation workflow: gather the task, derive design lenses, run N isolated worktree agents in parallel, then compare, pick a winner, and graft the best ideas from the runners-up.
author: Christophe1997

name: goalship
description: Decompose a goal into a tk ticket graph and drive it to merge-ready pull requests unattended — tiered decomposition, gated implementation, dependency-aware branching, and a self-pacing execution loop.
author: Christophe1997
